title: Tether POS & CRM
shortDesc: Multi-tenant SaaS retail CRM and POS platform with hardware integration.
longDesc: Comprehensive multi-tenant SaaS platform built for independent telecom retailers using Angular, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. Features ACID-compliant financial transactions, JSONB-driven dynamic inventory management, and direct integration with physical hardware peripherals like barcode scanners and receipt printers.

title: Bedrock Control
shortDesc: Event-driven AWS infrastructure management system for on-demand cloud hosting.
longDesc: Engineered an automated AWS cloud management system utilizing a containerized Discord bot to trigger dynamic EC2 deployments. Implemented serverless AWS Lambda functions to monitor network traffic, automatically back up data to S3, and terminate inactive instances, resulting in an 80% reduction in cloud costs. Provisioned via Terraform with secure IAM Roles Anywhere.

title: CheckInApp
shortDesc: React Native mobile application for real-time tutoring center management.
longDesc: Developed a React Native mobile application for tutoring center check-ins featuring offline-first capabilities and secure dynamic QR code validation. Engineered real-time state synchronization across clients via WebSockets and deployed the scalable containerized backend to AWS EC2.

title: Room To Grow
shortDesc: AI tutoring platform using multi-model routing, CV, and streaming responses.
longDesc: AI tutoring platform leveraging OpenRouter to dynamically orchestrate multiple LLMs. Features computer vision for diagram analysis, real-time streaming responses, and automated parsing of chat context into interactive flashcards and quizzes.

title: AR Stroke Rehabilitation
shortDesc: Augmented reality stroke recovery application built for Meta Quest 3.
longDesc: Developed an augmented reality medical rehabilitation tool for Meta Quest 3 using Unity and C#. Engineered a high-performance backend using Rust to process spatial data and track user recovery metrics in real-time.
